note: NGPC recreation area at a wooded Sandhills spring oasis east of Anselmo. 21 electric sites plus about 60 basic non-pad sites; ten of the electric sites book online, the rest first-come first-served. Two housekeeping cabins; small spring-fed pond with fishing and paddleboat rentals. Nebraska park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: RA park page + per-site catalog read: open year round, 81 sites (21 electric 30/50 A + 60 non-pad), 10 reservable 50 A / 50 ft Electric Plus sites (grass or gravel), 180-day window, 14-day max stay, showers, dump, water - written manual. Fees stay on the grid (no quote: no availability shown). Not waterfront stands; pin ~250 m off; phone (308) 749-2235 missing.
